patterns.note: Full-bleed photographic sections with overlaid text and calls-to-action create impactful visual breaks and a premium feel between product grids.
A high-contrast palette of black, white, and dark grey is consistently punctuated by a single vibrant orange accent, primarily used for branding elements, product packaging, and calls-to-action.
Section titles and key headings utilize a bold, uppercase sans-serif typeface, creating strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text.
The initial hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the overlaid text and button, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
Product display sections consistently use a clean, responsive grid layout with product images, titles, and prices, often highlighting the brand's distinctive orange packaging.

technique_notes: To achieve the hero parallax, the background image can be set with a fixed attachment or a slower scroll speed relative to the foreground content. Sections are revealed by standard scrolling, with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations potentially triggered by CSS keyframes as elements enter the viewport.
The navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, maintaining accessibility to key links without significant visual transformation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with uppercase section titles, complemented by a clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with slightly rounded corners on buttons and input fields, but predominantly sharp edges for overall layout elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with airy full-bleed hero and image sections, transitioning to a more compact but well-spaced grid for product displays.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, often moody photography combined with a bold, consistent orange accent color for product packaging and calls-to-action creates a strong, memorable brand identity that feels premium and authentic. The full-bleed image sections with overlaid text are particularly impactful.
